description: The Ehitisregister is Estonia's national register of buildings and structures and of the construction documents about them, such as building permits and notices, occupancy permits and energy labels. It holds data on existing, demolished and planned buildings, from flats and houses to factories and schools, and on structures such as wells, squares and windmills, drawing on the permit process, energy labels and outside sources such as the Land Administration. The open data are shared through the register's data warehouse, information portal and the Estonian open data gateway, and can be downloaded and machine-processed. Coverage: all of Estonia. Access: free through the open data APIs listed on swaggerui.ehr.ee, with an access guide on the EHR information portal; the portal entry says it updates daily. Licence: CC BY-SA 3.0. Caveats: ownership details are part of the register but not all fields are open; the old university page that described the data now returns 404. Simulation uses are national building exposure models, energy label based retrofit scenarios and school and public building inventories. Related records: the Estonian 3D building models from the Land and Spatial Development Board and the TABULA/EPISCOPE building typologies.
